notes.title: Game release today, and announcement of 8 majestic free DLCs!
notes.notes:
Summer is over already, but the game is here! Time to relive the summer you never had, and show off your manliness!

To celebrate THE INCREDIBLE and UNFORGETTABLE success of the games launch later today, we are extremely happy to announce that we have not 1, not 2, not 4, but 8 totally unique and totally manly DLCs coming for FREE during the coming week! DLCs such as "1 Gallon XXXL Beer", "Epic Gentleman Moustache" and "The Evil Piñata of Destruction"!
